chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Mu‘allā ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Awrama, from ‘Alī ibn Hassān, from ‘Abd al-Rahmān ibn Kathīr, who said:
about the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic: “Have you not seen those who exchanged the favor of Allah for disbelief”

— the verse. He عليه السلام said: “What is meant by it is Quraysh altogether, those who opposed the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله, set up war against him, and denied the bequest concerning his successor.”

key_terms.رَسُولَ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله, whom they opposed
key_terms.قُرَيْشًا: the tribe identified here as the intended referent of the verse
key_terms.كُفْرًا: disbelief or ingratitude by replacing Allah’s favor with rejection
key_terms.نِعْمَتَ اللَّهِ: the divine favor referred to in the verse, understood here in connection with divine guidance and authority
key_terms.وَصِيَّةَ: the bequest or designation that was denied

ai.seo_question: Who are those that changed the favor of Allah into disbelief according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the verse as referring to Quraysh collectively, specifically those who opposed the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله and fought against him. It further connects their ingratitude to their denial of the designation of his successor, framing the verse within the doctrine of wilayah and the rejection of divine favor.

en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Awrama, from Ali Bin Hassan, from Abdul Rahman Bin Kaseer who said,
about the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [14:28] Have you not seen those who have changed Allah's Favour for ungratefulness

– the Verse. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘It Means by it the (tribe of) Qureysh as a whole who were inimical to Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>, and they establish the war against him<sup>saww</sup>, and they rejected the bequest regarding his<sup>saww</sup> successor<sup>asws</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 4. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Mu‘alla ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn ’Uwarma from Ali ibn Hassa’n from ‘Abd al-Rahman ibn Kathir who has said that he asked abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.)
about the meaning of the following verse.
“Have you not seen (considered) those who changed the blessings (Word) of God through disbelief and led their people to destruction?” [14:28]
The Imam (a.s.) said it is a reference to all of Quraysh who exercised animosity towards the Holy Prophet (s.a.), created wars against him and rejected his will about his successor.”
